question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: WISDOM
solution:
The correct answer is: **Knowledge**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Wisdom"** refers to the quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgment; it is a deep understanding of life and its complexities. (बुद्धिमत्ता)
 
 
• **Example:** The wise old man shared his wisdom about the importance of kindness.
 
 
• **"Knowledge"** signifies information, understanding, and skills acquired through experience or education. It is an integral part of wisdom. (ज्ञान)
